 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the CrPC for grant of bail relating to Crime No. 188 of 2024 registered at Police Station Gola Ka Mandir, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 328, 344, 365, 366, 376 (2) (N), 376 (D), 506 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Gola Ka Mandir, District Gwalior
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated on account of the property dispute with the family of prosecutrix.
It is further argued that the applicant/accused helped the father of the prosecutrix to trace the prosecutrix when she eloped alongwith huge quantity of ornaments.

Further submission is that the prosecutrix made false allegations about her abduction and rape against the present applicant and co- accused Vishal Gupta, however, she had solemnized marriage with co-accused Vishal Gupta and even Protection Petition No.4891 of 2024 was filed by the prosecutrix before Allahabad High Court alleging that she had solemnized marriage with Vishal Gupta on 22.11.2023 and her family members were against the marriage, therefore, threatening them, therefore, the protection be granted to 2 MCRC-29284-2024 them.
Even in Adhar Card No.25323058169, the name of husband of prosecutrix is mentioned as Vishal Gupta.
It is further argued that the prosecutrix who is a major married woman mentioned different name of husbands in different forums.
There is a delay in lodging F.I.R. for which, no plausible explanation has been given.
Co-accused Vishal Gupta has already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 09.07.2024 in M.Cr.C.No.27420 of 2024.
The applicant is under custody since 06.06.2024.
The applicant is having no criminal antecedent.
Further argument is that applicant is resident of District - Jaloun (Uttar Pradesh) and there is no possibility of his absconsion and tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Hence, prayed for grant of bail to the applicant.

1 P e r contra, learned Public Prosecutor for respondent/the State has vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000 (Rupees One Lac Only) with two solvent sureties (out of which, one should be local surety since the applicant is resident of District Jaloun,
UP) to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal court.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE AK/-
